16037.subject: Government
16037.question_text: Local government reforms were carried out by the Federal Military Government in
16037.explanation:
The 1976 Local Government Reform was carried out by the Federal Military Government under General Olusegun Obasanjo.

It was a major turning point in Nigeria’s system of local administration because it:

  • Recognised local government as the third tier of government, distinct from federal and state governments.

  • Standardised the structure of local governments across the country.

  • Introduced elected councils to replace traditional or appointed administrators.

  • Ensured direct allocation of funds to local governments from the Federation Account.

16095.subject: Government
16095.question_text: The study of Government offers an individual all the following except a
16095.explanation:
The study of Government (Civic Education/Political Science) provides:

  • Knowledge of political systems

  • Understanding of rights and responsibilities

  • Civic awareness

  • Foundation for careers in public service, law, administration, diplomacy, etc.

However, it does not directly train someone to become a judge.

Becoming a judge requires:

  • Studying Law

  • Attending Law School

  • Legal practice experience

  • Judicial appointment

So while Government can provide background knowledge, it is not professional judicial training.
